verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the reverse direction: other clients like Outlook, Apple Mail and Thunderbird can connect to Gmail over IMAP/POP/SMTP. Nothing shows Gmail itself adding Microsoft 365 or generic IMAP accounts and managing them in one place. Delegation and API access are adjacent features, not multi-provider account aggregation.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
